name: Leadville Loppet 44k skate
description:
I believe your 8th time on Nordic skate skis is traditionally supposed to be a full marathon.

My recording lost a few miles and a couple hundred feet of vert because my big dumb glove paused my watch.

Official time: 3:15:52
Official pace: 7:09


Skis felt sluggish and I got passed on the downhills (although to be fair I got passed on the uphills too). Either waxed poorly or chose the wrong wax or I’m just slow.

Carried a hydration bladder with 30 ounces of water, which was definitely unnecessary as there were no less than 6 aid stations, very well run and marked.

Right glute really dying at the end.

Next stop Salt Lake City
